name: Exp_Digital_MACD
summary: This EA trades based on the Digital_MACD custom indicator, offering four different entry algorithms: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD/Signal crossover. It supports configurable position sizing, stop loss/take profit, and permission toggles for long/short entry and exit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Digital_MACD指标进行交易，提供四种不同的入场算法：零线突破、MACD方向变化、信号线方向变化和MACD与信号线交叉。支持可配置的仓位管理、止损止盈以及多空开平仓权限开关。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于数字MACD指标的动量交易，提供了四种入场模式供用户选择。'breakdown'模式在MACD柱状图穿越零线时入场，属于趋势确认型策略；'MACDtwist'模式在MACD线改变方向时入场，属于动量反转策略；'SIGNALtwist'模式在信号线改变方向时入场，反应更平滑；'MACDdisposition'模式在MACD线穿越信号线时入场，即经典MACD交叉策略。出场方面，EA使用固定的止损和止盈点数（默认1000点和2000点），同时反向信号也会触发平仓。仓位管理支持按存款比例计算手数（MM参数默认0.1），并通过MarginMode枚举选择手数计算方式。EA在每根新K线时计算信号，避免逐tick交易的噪音，但缺乏加仓、减仓和移动止损机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on the Digital_MACD custom indicator, offering four selectable entry modes. The 'breakdown' mode enters when the MACD histogram crosses the zero line, acting as a trend confirmation strategy. The 'MACDtwist' mode enters when the MACD line changes direction, functioning as a momentum reversal strategy. The 'SIGNALtwist' mode enters when the signal line changes direction, providing a smoother signal response. The 'MACDdisposition' mode enters on MACD/signal line crossover, which is the classic MACD crossover approach. For exits, the EA uses fixed stop loss and take profit in points (default 1000 and 2000), while opposing signals also trigger position closure. Position sizing supports deposit-share-based lot calculation (MM parameter default 0.1) with a MarginMode enum for lot calculation method selection. The EA calculates signals on each new bar to avoid tick-level noise, but lacks scaling, partial close, and trailing stop mechanisms.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每笔交易占用存款比例

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (fixed lot or percentage)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 提供四种不同的入场算法模式，灵活度高，适应不同市场环境
支持多空方向独立的开平仓权限控制，风险管控粒度细
基于新K线计算信号，避免逐tick频繁交易，减少假信号和交易成本
使用自定义Digital_MACD指标，信号处理比标准MACD更精细
止损止盈参数可配置，默认2:1的盈亏比有利于长期正期望
pros_en: Offers four different entry algorithm modes with high flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Supports independent permission control for long/short entry and exit with fine-grained risk management
Calculates signals on new bars only, avoiding tick-level overtrading and reducing false signals and trading costs
Uses the custom Digital_MACD indicator for more refined signal processing than standard MACD
Configurable stop loss and take profit with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio favorable for long-term positive expectancy
cons: 缺乏移动止损（Trailing Stop）机制，无法在盈利时锁定浮动利润
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR），在不同波动环境下风险不均匀
依赖自定义指标Digital_MACD，若该指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
没有加仓和减仓逻辑，错失趋势加仓优化机会
未包含点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
cons_en: Lacks a trailing stop mechanism, unable to lock in floating profits during favorable moves
Fixed point-based stop loss and take profit without ATR-based volatility adaptation leads to uneven risk across varying volatility environments
Depends on the custom Digital_MACD indicator file; EA will fail to initialize if the indicator is missing
No position scaling (add/reduce) logic, missing opportunities to pyramid into strong trends
No spread filter included, potentially leading to unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使风险管理自适应市场波动率
添加移动止损功能，在盈利达到阈值后自动跟踪价格保护利润
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for volatility-adaptive risk management
Implement a trailing stop feature to automatically protect profits once a threshold is reached

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，极端行情下止损可能过小或过大
依赖外部自定义指标文件，存在初始化失败的风险
MM参数默认0.1为存款的10%，在杠杆较高时单笔风险偏大
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit without volatility adaptation may be too tight or too loose during extreme market conditions
Dependency on external custom indicator file creates initialization failure risk
MM parameter default of 0.1 (10% of deposit) per trade represents significant single-trade risk at high leverage
